title: Settlement of a Submitted Dental, Vision or Hearing Line Under a Rider
content:
Where a provider has submitted a dental, vision or hearing line under one of the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders and the line stands on the member's benefit history awaiting a decision, the plan settles it: the benefit the rider pays is recorded against the line, the remainder of the line's allowed amount stands as what the member owes the provider, and the benefit is added to what the rider has paid toward the benefit year's maximum.

## Conditions the settlement waits on

A benefit is not settled on a submitted line until the rider it is claimed under stands in force with no rider premium outstanding against it.

What is left of the benefit year's maximum is not worked out before a reversal stands on the member's benefit history against every settled line the plan has marked as adjusted.

## Invoking the settlement

The settlement is made with `settle_rider_benefit_line_e49937be`. The representative unlocks the tool and then calls it themselves; it is not handed to the member.

### Parameters

- `osb_rider_id` — Id class. The reference number of the member's optional supplemental benefit rider the line is claimed under, as it stands in the member's rider records.
- `osb_benefit_claim_id` — Id class. The reference number of the single submitted claim line to be settled, as it stands in the member's rider benefit claim history.
- `osb_rider_request_id` — Id class. The reference number of the rider service request carrying the treatment plan the plan answered for this service, read from the member's rider service requests. An empty string is passed where the service needed no treatment plan.
- `rider_paid_amount` — Fixed-format class. The benefit the rider pays on this line, in USD to 2 decimal places, as a plain positive number with no currency sign. It is stored rounded to 2 decimal places, and an amount of zero is written as 0.00.

### What the call does

The line is marked paid, the benefit stated is recorded against it as what the rider paid, the remainder of the line's allowed amount is recorded as what the member owes the provider, no denial reason is carried, and the settlement is dated with today's date. The same benefit is added to the benefit the rider has paid toward this benefit year's maximum, so the member's remaining maximum falls by that much.

### Return

A confirmation sentence naming the settled claim line's reference number, the benefit recorded as paid by the rider in USD, the amount left as the member's own, and the benefit the rider has now paid toward this benefit year's maximum. The sentence being returned at all is what indicates the line has been settled.

## Basis Q&A

**What does the settled line show the member and the provider?** What the rider paid and what is left for the member to pay.

**What is recorded as the member's own share?** The remainder of the line's allowed amount, once the benefit the rider pays is taken off it.

**What is passed where the service needed no treatment plan?** An empty string in place of the rider service request reference.
